# How Much Does AppsFlyer Cost for a Small Subscription App?

H

Hyunjong ChoiGTM Lead

October 14, 2026·Updated October 14, 2026·6 min read

Share

![How Much Does AppsFlyer Cost for a Small Subscription App?](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fqhzcaeifhsdzzjpnbdqr.supabase.co%2Fstorage%2Fv1%2Fobject%2Fpublic%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fappsflyer-pricing-small-apps-cover-1791942640688.webp&w=1920&q=75)

## Key takeaways

*   AppsFlyer's published Growth rate is $0.07 per attributed conversion after the Welcome Package, so 10,000 conversions a month costs about $700 before premium add-ons.
*   AppsFlyer bills attributed installs, re-engagements, and re-attributions, while organic installs and in-app events such as trial starts and renewals are not billed as conversions.
*   Protect360, Data Locker, ROI360, and Audiences are sold separately without published prices, so the pricing page alone cannot show your full AppsFlyer cost.
*   Airbridge's Core Plan bills by data points at $40+/mo with 500K included, so a month with 1M data points costs $90.

On this page▾

AppsFlyer's Growth plan charges $0.07 per attributed conversion after a Welcome Package of 12,000 free conversions in the first 12 months. A subscription app with 10,000 attributed conversions a month would pay about $700 a month once the Welcome Package is used up, before premium add-ons like Protect360 fraud protection. AppsFlyer does not publish add-on prices, so your total cost depends on conversion volume and which premium features you need.

## AppsFlyer's pricing structure explained

AppsFlyer bills per attributed conversion rather than a monthly fee. Here is how each plan works, per [AppsFlyer's pricing page](https://www.appsflyer.com/pricing/):

**Zero plan (free)**

*   Described by AppsFlyer as for apps using [owned media](https://www.airbridge.io/en/glossary/owned-media "Owned media"), and "not suitable for apps with paid activities"
*   Includes the Welcome Package: 12,000 free conversions to use within the first 12 months
*   Covers core marketing analytics

**Growth plan (pay-as-you-go)**

*   $0.07 per attributed conversion after the Welcome Package
*   A conversion is an attributed install, [re-engagement](https://www.airbridge.io/en/glossary/re-engagement "Re-engagement"), or re-attribution
*   Organic installs are not counted and are free
*   The Welcome Package includes a 30-day trial of select premium add-ons
*   Premium products such as Protect360, Data Locker, Audiences, API access, and ROI360 are sold separately
*   Includes OneLink [deep linking](https://www.airbridge.io/en/glossary/deep-linking "Deep linking") and SKAN Conversion Studio

**Enterprise plan (custom)**

*   Custom pricing through AppsFlyer's sales team
*   Adds features such as real-time ad spend aggregation

## What a small subscription app actually pays

The table shows the Growth-plan cost at different volumes, after the 12,000-conversion Welcome Package is used up. It uses AppsFlyer's published $0.07 rate and excludes add-ons.

| Monthly attributed conversions | AppsFlyer Growth cost | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1,000 | $70/mo | Covered by the Welcome Package for about the first year |
| 5,000 | $350/mo | Typical for early growth |
| 10,000 | $700/mo | Before add-ons |
| 25,000 | $1,750/mo | Mid-growth |
| 50,000 | $3,500/mo | Teams at this volume often negotiate Enterprise pricing |

**What counts as a conversion?** Attributed installs, re-engagements, and re-attributions. Organic installs are not billed, and [in-app events](https://www.airbridge.io/en/glossary/in-app-events "In-app events") such as trial starts, purchases, and renewals are not billed as conversions. So for a subscription app, the bill tracks paid acquisition volume, not how many events each user generates.

## The add-on question

Several features that subscription-app teams commonly want are premium products on AppsFlyer, sold separately from the per-[conversion rate](https://www.airbridge.io/en/glossary/conversion-rate "Conversion Rate"):

*   **Protect360** — fraud protection
*   **Data Locker** — raw data export to your warehouse or BI tools
*   **ROI360** — cost and revenue analytics, including more complete store subscription measurement (refunds, net revenue)
*   **Audiences** — audience segmentation and activation

AppsFlyer does not publish add-on pricing. You need to contact sales for a quote, so your total cost is not fully knowable from the pricing page alone.

Want to see how AppsFlyer pricing works with your data?

Get hands-on with Airbridge and see real results.

[Try It Free →](https://app.airbridge.io/signup?from=en_blog_inline&selected_plan=ABR_CORE)

## How AppsFlyer compares to a monthly-priced alternative

Airbridge's Core Plan uses a different billing unit: data points, where 1 data point is 1 event Airbridge collects for your app (installs, app opens, trial starts, purchases, including events from RevenueCat, Adapty, or Superwall). Tracking-link clicks and ad impressions do not count.

|     | AppsFlyer Growth | Airbridge Core Plan |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Billing unit | Attributed conversions | Data points (events) |
| Price | $0.07 per attributed conversion | $40+/mo |
| Free start | Welcome Package: 12,000 conversions in the first 12 months | 30-day free trial, no data point limits |
| Included usage | Welcome Package only | 500K data points per month |
| After that | $0.07 per attributed conversion | $0.0001 per data point |
| Fraud protection | Protect360 (add-on) | Included in the Growth Plan (Fraud Validation Rules) |
| Raw data export | Data Locker (add-on) | Growth Plan |
| Annual contract | Growth is pay-as-you-go; Enterprise is custom | No annual contract, cancel anytime |
| Self-serve signup | Yes, but users report a long, complex setup | Yes |

Because the units differ, compare them against your own numbers. Your AppsFlyer bill depends on attributed conversions. Your Airbridge bill depends on total events: $40 a month covers up to 500K data points, and a month with 1M data points costs $40 + (500K × $0.0001) = $90. Airbridge's Core Plan also includes revenue reports, Predictive LTV (180 days), and audience sync to ad networks without an add-on.

For a head-to-head of the two billing models, see [AppsFlyer vs Airbridge Pricing](https://www.airbridge.io/en/blog/appsflyer-vs-airbridge-pricing). For a full side-by-side of features, see [Airbridge vs AppsFlyer](https://www.airbridge.io/en/compare/airbridge-vs-appsflyer) and [Best Mobile App Attribution Software for Subscription Apps](https://www.airbridge.io/en/blog/best-mobile-attribution-subscription-apps). For a broader look at alternatives, see [Best AppsFlyer Alternatives for Subscription App Attribution](https://www.airbridge.io/en/blog/appsflyer-alternatives-subscription-apps).

# AppsFlyer Pricing 2026: A Complete Breakdown of Plans & Costs

AppsFlyer's pricing can be complex. This guide breaks down the free, growth, and enterprise tiers to help you budget effectively. Talk to an AppsFlyer expert at metacto to ensure a flawless, cost-effective integration.

August 31, 2025•5 min read

[Keep Reading](https://www.metacto.com/blogs/the-complete-guide-to-appsflyer-costs-setup-integration-maintenance#body)[Talk to an expert](https://www.metacto.com/blogs/the-complete-guide-to-appsflyer-costs-setup-integration-maintenance#cta-form)

![Garrett Fritz](/_astro/garrett-fritz.5wHkCS4-_Z1jdONu.webp)

By Garrett Fritz•Partner & CTO

![AppsFlyer Pricing 2026: A Complete Breakdown of Plans & Costs](/_astro/the-complete-guide-to-appsflyer-costs-setup-integration-maintenance.BDyVkhzP_11o7ts.webp)

> **Updated May 2026:** This guide reflects AppsFlyer’s current pricing structure, including the latest conversion rates, Welcome Package details, and enterprise negotiation benchmarks.

Trying to figure out how much AppsFlyer costs can feel complicated. With multiple tiers, usage-based pricing, and premium add-ons, it’s easy to get lost. As a leading mobile attribution platform, AppsFlyer is a powerful investment for [app growth](https://www.metacto.com/services/app-growth), but you need to know exactly what you’re paying for.

At [metacto](https://www.metacto.com/), we’ve helped dozens of companies navigate this exact challenge. We’ve integrated [AppsFlyer](https://www.metacto.com/technologies/appsflyer) for businesses of all sizes, giving us a clear view of the real-world costs. This guide breaks down AppsFlyer’s pricing structure, analyzes each plan, and reveals the hidden factors that affect your final bill.

**Short on time? Here’s the quick summary:** AppsFlyer offers three main pricing tiers: a **Free “Zero” plan** for apps with under 12,000 lifetime non-organic installs, a **“Growth” plan** that scales with usage, and a custom **“Enterprise” plan** for large-scale advertisers.

## AppsFlyer Pricing Plans: At a Glance

To simplify the options, here is a high-level comparison of the three main AppsFlyer pricing plans. This table helps you quickly identify the best starting point for your business.

| Feature | Zero Plan (Free) | Growth Plan | Enterprise Plan |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Cost** | $0  | $0.07/conversion after Welcome Package | Custom ($0.03-$0.05/conversion negotiated) |
| **Best For** | Startups & Pre-Launch Apps | Small to Medium Businesses | Large-Scale Advertisers (1M+ conversions) |
| **Welcome Package** | 12,000 free conversions (first year) | 12,000 free conversions (first year) | Included in contract |
| **Non-Organic Installs** | Up to 12,000 (Lifetime) | Pay-as-you-go (unlimited) | Custom / Unlimited |
| **Media Sources** | Owned Media Only | All Media Sources | All Media Sources |
| **SKAN 4.0 Support** | ✅   | ✅   | ✅   |
| **Basic Fraud Protection** | ❌   | ✅ (Protect360 basic) | ✅ (Protect360 advanced) |
| **Data Locker (Raw Data)** | ❌   | ❌ (1M row API limit) | ✅ (Unlimited exports) |
| **Incrementality Testing** | ❌   | ✅   | ✅   |
| **AI Agents Hub** | ❌   | ❌   | ✅   |
| **Support** | Community & Docs | Email Support | Dedicated CSM (2-hour SLA) |

## Deep Dive: AppsFlyer Pricing Tiers

AppsFlyer’s pricing is primarily based on the number of non-organic app installs (conversions) you track per month. This metric reflects the paid marketing efforts you’re measuring. Let’s break down what you get with each plan.

### 1\. The Zero Plan (Free Tier)

The **Zero plan** is AppsFlyer’s free offering, designed for apps that are just starting out or have a small user base. It’s an excellent way to build a foundation for data-driven marketing without an initial investment.

*   **Cost:** $0
*   **Best For:** Startups, indie developers, and apps in the pre-launch or early growth phase. Ideal for validating an idea with a [rapid MVP development](https://www.metacto.com/solutions/mvp-web-app) approach.
*   **Welcome Package:** 12,000 free conversions to use within your first 12 months, plus a 30-day trial of premium add-ons.
*   **Key Limitation:** Limited to **12,000 lifetime non-organic installs**. This is the most critical factor. Once you cross this threshold, you must upgrade.

#### Zero Plan Feature Breakdown

| Feature | Details |
| --- | --- |
| **Attribution** | Unlimited owned media sources (email, QR codes, social profiles, web-to-app). |
| **iOS Support** | Full SKAdNetwork (SKAN) 4.0 dashboard with three postback windows and coarse-grained conversion values. |
| **Deep Linking** | Basic capabilities through AppsFlyer’s OneLink technology. |
| **Analytics** | Core marketing analytics with overview reports and retention insights. |
| **Premium Trial** | 30-day access to premium add-ons for evaluation. |
| **Support** | Community support and access to documentation. |

The Zero plan is a fantastic way to integrate a powerful attribution tool without any upfront cost. However, any app with a serious user acquisition budget will outgrow it quickly.

### 2\. The Growth Plan

The **Growth plan** is the most common tier for small to medium-sized businesses that are actively spending on user acquisition and need to measure ROI across all their channels.

*   **Cost:** **$0.07 per conversion** after your Welcome Package of 12,000 free conversions. Note: As of February 2026, connected TV, PC, and console platform installs are also charged at the $0.07 rate.
*   **Best For:** Apps with a consistent marketing budget and a growing number of non-organic installs.
*   **Annual Cost Examples:**
    *   50K monthly conversions: ~$42,000/year
    *   100K monthly conversions: ~$84,000/year
    *   200K monthly conversions: ~$168,000/year

#### Growth Plan Feature Breakdown

| Feature | Details |
| --- | --- |
| **Everything in Zero** | Includes all features from the free tier. |
| **Paid Media Attribution** | Track **all media sources**, including major ad networks like Meta, Google, and TikTok. 90+ partner integrations. |
| **Advanced Analytics** | Cohort analysis, retention reports, and LTV analytics. |
| **Fraud Protection** | Protect360 for basic install fraud protection. |
| **Raw Data Access** | Raw Data API with 1M row limit (Data Locker requires Enterprise). |
| **Incrementality Testing** | Measure true campaign impact beyond attribution. |
| **Premium Add-ons** | 30-day trials available; custom dashboards ($5,000-$30,000/year), advanced fraud suite ($10,000-$50,000+/year). |

The Growth plan offers the core functionality most marketers need. The key is to accurately forecast your monthly conversions to estimate your costs.
